name: io.github.travisbergen2/second-brain
title: Explicit Formula — Second Brain
description: Your own notes, searched and cited by your AI — local-only, allowlist-gated, capped, and logged.

packageArguments.name: --vault
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md notes).

packageArguments.name: --allow
packageArguments.description: Optional override of the folder allowlist (comma-separated, relative to the vault). Normally omitted: the server follows the Explicit Formula Obsidian plugin's 'Folders the loop may read' setting live. Without either, all reads are off.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.privacy: local-only; folder allowlist off by default; ≤6 snippets/2400 chars per search; per-call disclosure; vault-side access log (mcp-audit.md)
